title: Regime-Bound Measurement in Complex Systems: Proxy, Placement, and Validity
abstract: Formalizes a general, validity-aware measurement framework in which analysis is cartography—mapping outputs on a structured response surface—rather than a single verdict. It introduces five operative concepts (regime, proxy, placement, episenter, compression) and applies them to two domains (cosmology via WP3/R(k,S) and AI evaluation), deriving falsifiable predictions and criteria that distinguish regime-stable claims from locally coherent artifacts.
